meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在写代码前会自动从 Qodo 平台获取团队编码规则，并在生成代码时强制遵守这些规则，同时添加合规注释。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写、修改、重构或审查代码，或开始实现规划时触发。如果对话中已有“Qodo Rules Loaded”则跳过。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录功能，先加载 Qodo 规则。
say.note: 触发规则加载，然后生成符合团队标准的代码。

say.text: 重构这个模块，应用 Qodo 规则。
say.note: 加载规则后执行重构，确保遵守编码标准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically fetches team coding rules from Qodo before writing code, enforces them during generation, and adds compliance comments for ERROR rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning. Skipped if 'Qodo Rules Loaded' is already in context.

say_en.text: Write a login function, load Qodo rules first.
say_en.note: Triggers rule loading, then generates code compliant with team standards.

say_en.text: Refactor this module applying Qodo rules.
say_en.note: Loads rules and refactors while adhering to coding standards.
